title: No hay agua
goal: Find out when the water is coming back
culture: The mains go off down here for days at a time and everybody stores water in barrels. Nobody announces anything, so the neighbour who listens to the pipes IS the information system. Getting yourself onto that list is what this mission is for.

beats.objective: Say there is none at your house
beats.say: No hay agua en mi casa.
beats.en: There’s no water at my house.
ok: no hay agua en mi casa
beats.good: No hay agua is a sentence you will say and hear constantly down here. It is not a complaint, it is the weather report.

beats.es: Aquí tampoco. Desde el martes, fíjese.
beats.good: Three days already. Repeating the day back is how you find out whether this is bad or normal, and down here it is normal.

beats.es: Desde el martes, sí. Yo tengo dos barriles llenos, gracias a Dios.
beats.objective: Ask when it is coming back
beats.en: And when is it coming back?
beats.good: Nobody from the company will tell you, so asking a neighbour is not a workaround — it is the system, and he will know before they do.

beats.es: Quién sabe. Pero yo oigo el ruido en los tubos y aviso a todos.
beats.objective: Ask him to let you know
beats.good: Avíseme — let me know. Asking to be told is how you get plugged into a barrio that runs entirely on being told things.
